additional_condition: Within the same last 4 closed 15M candles, at least one matching retest candle must start at or after the selected 4H breakout close. The confirmation candle may also be that retest candle.
entry_policy: Replay in time order and track first entry separately for each model, including warmup and missing-history exclusions.
universe: Current tradable contracts. Historical delisted contracts unavailable; not a forward/live validation.
decision_policy: No threshold tuning or auto-promotion. Retrospective results never count toward live resolved>=20 gate.
